scripts.start:backend: cd backend && npm run build && node dist/server.js
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.stop: powershell -Command "netstat -ano | findstr ':5000\|:3000\|:3001\|:5555' | ForEach-Object { $parts = $_ -split '\s+'; if ($parts.Length -gt 4 -and $parts[4] -ne '0') { Stop-Process -Id $parts[4] -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }"
